public_sms_split: Normalized-message hash buckets: 0-6 train, 7 validation, 8-9 test. First 100 ham and 100 spam test records ordered by group hash.
public_sms_limit: Old public English SMS data; unknown overlap with Laya training. Not a phishing benchmark or proof of unseen-source generalization.
challenge_limit: Original authored email/form/community messages, labels frozen before inference but not independently reviewed.
rules: Preserve all failures and keep failed predictions in denominators.
Do not tune prompts or thresholds on the test set.
Report public SMS and authored challenges separately.
Do not interpret raw probability as calibrated correctness.
Bedrock comparison is offline only; it never supplies Laya predictions.
No real message delivery or security enforcement occurs in the demo.
